D/ IV[L] CRISPVS [NOB CAES] ; R/ [TRANQVILLIT]AS, in ex TR

Copper alloy nummus of Crispus Date: 323-324 Diameter 18mm, weight 2.63g Obverse: beaded cuirassed bust facing left holding a spear and shield Obverse inscription: IV[L] CRISPVS [NOB CAES] Reverse: Alter inscribed VOT/IS/XX globe above, the top right section is missing Reverse inscription: [TRANQVILLIT]AS, in ex TR Mint: Trier (Germany) Condition: poor
